    "label_pick = [i for i, name in enumerate(cat.categories) if name in picked_cell_type]\n",
    "\n",
    "from collections import defaultdict\n",
    "def sampling(source, num_sample, label_pick):\n",
    "    class_indices = defaultdict(list)\n",
    "    for idx, label in enumerate(source):\n",
    "        class_indices[label].append(idx)\n",
    "\n",
    "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)  # Set a seed for reproducibility\n",
    "    sampled_indices = []\n",
    "    for label, indices in class_indices.items():\n",
    "        if label in label_pick:\n",
    "            n_class_samples = min(len(indices), num_sample)  # Equal sampling\n",
    "            sampled_indices.extend(list(rng.choice(indices, n_class_samples, replace=False)))\n",
    "    return sampled_indices\n",
    "\n",

write_file({"relative_path":"workspace/sample_c_elegans.py","content":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# URLs from docs/tutorials/c_elegans.ipynb but using main branch
# Data is large; we only need metadata to sample cell types
data_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final.txt"
metadata_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final_metadata.txt"

# Read metadata
metadata = pd.read_csv(metadata_url)

picked = ["Ciliated_amphid_neuron", "Pharyngeal_neuron", "GLR", "Glia",
          "Body_wall_muscle", "Pharyngeal_muscle","Hypodermis", "Intestine"]

# Check column name for cell type
col_candidates = [c for c in metadata.columns if 'cell' in c.lower()]
print('cell_type_column_candidates:', col_candidates)

cell_col = None
for c in col_candidates:
    if any(x in metadata[c].astype(str).unique() for x in picked):
        cell_col = c
        break
print('using cell column:', cell_col)

# Perform stratified sampling: up to 100 per selected type
sampled_indices = []
for t in picked:
    group = metadata[metadata[cell_col]==t]
    n = min(100, len(group))
    if n>0:
        sampled = group.sample(n=n, random_state=42)
        sampled_indices.extend(sampled.index.tolist())
    print(f"Type {t}: available={len(group)}, sampled={n}")

print('Total sampled:', len(sampled_indices))
"})
